title: signoff.json
description: Repo-level opt-in for SignOff: a committed declaration makes every clone run the five gates without a local install step.

gates.description: Documentation only; the guard always runs P1-P5.

test_cmd.description: Pinned test command. Omit it unless every clone has that runner.

budget.description: Seconds a gate may spend before it counts as a failure.

pre_push.description: Run the full set before a push too.

secrets.description: Secret scanning before P1. false disables it; an object accepts {allow: [rule or rule:path]}.

cache.description: Cache the P1 verdict per staged tree (default true).

docsFast.description: Skip the suite when every staged file is a document (default true).

coverage.description: Run signoff cov in the guard. true means min 80; {min: 90} sets the threshold.

sign.description: Sign the commit trailer (needs a key).

sign_key.description: Path to the private key used for trailers.
